title: Jewelry Veteran Robert Manse Joins ShineBright as Sales & Marketing President
text: Press Releases Jewelry Veteran Robert Manse Joins ShineBright as Sales & Marketing President Robert will lead sales and marketing, strengthening retail partnerships, boosting brand positioning, and expanding distribution. Published 2 days ago on April 16, 2026 By Press Releases Share Tweet (PRESS RELEASE) NEW YORK, NY — ShineBright/ Dynamic Design Group, a leading supplier of high-quality natural and lab-grown diamond jewelry since 1995, announced the appointment of Robert Manse, a seasoned jewelry executive with over 30 years of experience, as President of Sales and Marketing. Robert brings a proven track record as a brand builder and product visionary, having generated more than $200 million in branded retail sales across major retailers and home shopping networks. His deep expertise spans the entire product lifecycle—from concept and design through sourcing, manufacturing, brand positioning, and national distribution—enabling him to transform creative visions into commercially successful collections that resonate with both consumers and retail buyers. “I am thrilled to join the talented team at ShineBright and Dynamic Design Group,” said Robert Manse. “This company has built a strong reputation for delivering exceptional quality diamond jewelry, and I look forward to leveraging my experience in retail partnerships, TV shopping strategies, and utilizing my key industry relationships to accelerate growth, expand market presence, and drive revenue across both natural and lab-grown segments.” In his new role, Robert will lead sales and marketing initiatives, focusing on strengthening partnerships with major retailers, buying groups, and trade shows while enhancing brand positioning and expanding distribution channels. His strategic oversight will include P&L management, supply chain optimization, and helping support high-performing sales teams to capitalize on opportunities in the evolving diamond jewelry market. Dynamic Design Group, established in 1995 and based in New York’s diamond district, has long been recognized for supplying jewelry stores nationwide with superior diamond jewelry. Shine Bright, its lab-grown diamond division, complements this heritage by offering ethically sourced, high-quality man-made diamonds and finished jewelry that meet the growing demand for accessible luxury at competitive prices. “Robert Manse’s extensive industry relationships and proven ability to scale branded collections make him an ideal addition to our leadership team,” said Amit Sanghavi, CEO of Dynamic Design Group. “His vision and execution will be instrumental as we continue to innovate and grow in both traditional and lab-grown diamond categories.” Advertisement Related Topics: Dynamic Design GroupleadershipmanagementMarketingsalesShineBright click to Comment(Comment) Up Next JIS Launches Brand Exposure Program for Exhibitors and Retailers Don't Miss India’s Gem Exports Hit $27.72B, Signaling Diversified Global Growth Advertisement SPONSORED VIDEO After 35 Years in Kent, Bonaci Fine Jewelers Found the Right Partner to Close the Right Way Bob Bonaci spent 35 years building a jewelry business and community presence in Kent, Washington.
